On referrals: only direct invitees count, and only by what they produce. Accounts that never complete a task add nothing; headcount earns no credit.
Alliance tasks — built with ecosystem partners — award Axis Points plus a partner reward. Campaign terms apply. See How Tasks Work.

Points track data produced, not time spent. Three things move them fastest, because they are what the pipeline is short of.
The Hub now caps each task at 5 completions per account, and what counts for that task is the average score across your completions of it — not your best one. Repeating a task you already did well can therefore lower what it is worth to you: a few sloppy repeats pull the average down. Repeat a task to do it better, not to do it more.

Calculation and settlement run over the weekend. Points land in your account on the following Monday at 12:00 UTC.

Both phases run on the same gate: a submission counts only once it is signed on-chain, with a transaction recorded on Base. Completing a task is not the last step; signing it is.
